label: Actual-giver presence controls: B2 without an actual giver, and presence omitted in both routes
paraphrase: Premise-free finite control in one two-world Bool frame (a structural interpretation, not a metaphysical possibility claim): the mover true exists at the reading world and is absent at the other; its only CAUSE_2 edge at esse is from false, which exists at no world. B2 holds and the actual-giver endpoint fails, so B2 does not entail the endpoint. With the mover's esse received in some principle, R1 and the reception-to-CAUSE_2 coverage hold (route 1's other premises); with everything in act, essence the being itself and every esse the principle false, B6, selected-world actuality and the q.3 a.4 reading hold (route 2's other premises). The world-presence interface fails in this frame and so does the endpoint, so neither route yields the endpoint without it.
